name: Vardhman Textiles Limited
summary: Vardhman Textiles Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cotton and synthetic yarn, woven fabrics, and garments in India and internationally. It operates through Textiles and Fibre segments. The company offers greige and dyed yarns in cotton, polyester, acrylic, and various blends; specialty yarns, such as organic cotton, melange, core-spun, gassed mercerised, and super-fine variants, as well as recycle cotton, linen and hemp blended, low pill, sustainable and performance, easy care stretchable, sustainable blended and slub, textured slub, cloud soft, and linen-luxe yarns; fabrics, such as piece dyed, yarn dyed, printed, fiber blends, weaved, and specialty finishes; …
